messages:
Carla B: Hi all  I flew to Amsterdam yesterday but my ferry back was when I left the city, and the operator only gave me a small receipt stub (no VAT). Can I just upload a phone pic and still claim travel? Also my flight landed at 14:40, caught a 17:30 train home do I get full or half per diem for that return day?
Jordan (People Ops): hey Carla :wave: phone pic of the stub is fine for transport receipts. Make sure the date, route and amount are legible. If merchant name is missing, put the operator name in the expense notes.
Carla B: cool thanks. the stub has a handwritten stamp and total but no company printed VAT line.
Mina (Finance): acceptable for <=  150 for EU records; if it's above that we may ask for a card statement screenshot. For currency differences, upload the original receipt image and select the original currency in Expensify.
Tom A: quick tip if the payment cleared on your card later, attach the card transaction screenshot to help reconcile.
Carla B: good idea, will do. about the per diem?
Jordan (People Ops): per diem prorata: departure/return days are tiered — full if away >12 hours, half if 612 hours, none if <6. Arrival at 14:40 and onward travel makes that return day typically >6h so you'd claim half. Add travel times in the expense notes so approvers can see the math.
Mina (Finance): also tag as Travel:Transport and Meal per diem separately if you claim food. If you accidentally charged meals to the company card, mark them as "personal meal" and note why.
Carla B: submitted with stub photo + card screenshot + note "flight arrived 14:40, train 17:30, return travel day - half per diem".
ExpensesBot: Helpful links: Expense policy  https://company.docs/expenses/travel ; Attaching foreign receipts  https://company.docs/expenses/receipts
Jordan (People Ops): Approved from People Ops side, Mina will finalize in finance queue. Ping if finance asks for anything else. :white_check_mark:
